'''Vannis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was the commander of [[Dorn Base]] and at some point, ventured into the [[Icefall Plains/Legends|Icefall Plains]] with a trooper party, going missing soon after. In [[3642 BBY]], his body was found inside a [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] [[Frostbite Redoubt|fortification]] by an Imperial-aligned individual.
